    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    T = int(input[0])
    results = []
    index = 1
    for _ in range(T):
        P = input[index]
        current_jump = 1
        days = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(P) - 1:
            if P[i] == '.':
                j = i
                while j < len(P) and P[j] == '.':
                    j += 1
                gap = j - i
                if gap > current_jump:
                    current_jump = gap
                    days += 1
                i = j
            else:
                i += 1
        results.append(str(days))
        index += 1
    print('\n'.join(results))
